#ifndef ZEPHYR_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_TEST_H_
#define ZEPHYR_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_TEST_H_

#include <zephyr/kernel.h>
#include <zephyr/sys/iterable_sections.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

struct ztest_unit_test {
	const char *name;
	void (*test)(void);
	void (*setup)(void);
	void (*teardown)(void);
};

struct ztest_suite_node {
	const char *name;
	const struct ztest_unit_test *unit_tests;
	bool has_run;
	void (*suite_setup)(void);
	void (*suite_teardown)(void);
	void (*before)(void *data);
	void (*after)(void *data);
};

/**
 * @defgroup ztest_test Ztest testing macros
 * @ingroup ztest
 *
 * This module provides the ztest testing framework.
 *
 * @{
 */

/**
 * @brief Define a test case.
 *
 * @param fn Function name for the test case.
 */
#define ztest_unit_test(fn) \
	{ \
		.name = #fn, \
		.test = fn, \
		.setup = NULL, \
		.teardown = NULL, \
	}

/**
 * @brief Define a test case with setup and teardown functions.
 *
 * @param fn Function name for the test case.
 * @param setup Function to run before the test case.
 * @param teardown Function to run after the test case.
 */
#define ztest_unit_test_setup_teardown(fn, setup, teardown) \
	{ \
		.name = #fn, \
		.test = fn, \
		.setup = setup, \
		.teardown = teardown, \
	}

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite.
 *
 * @param suite Name of the test suite.
 * @param ... List of test cases.
 */
#define ztest_test_suite(suite, ...) \
	static const Z_STRUCT_SECTION_ITERABLE(ztest_suite_node, suite##_suite_node) = { \
		.name = #suite, \
		.unit_tests = (const struct ztest_unit_test[]){\
			__VA_ARGS__, \
			{ 0 } \
		}, \
	}

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite with a setup and teardown functions.
 *
 * @param suite Name of the test suite.
 * @param suite_setup Function to run before the test suite.
 * @param suite_teardown Function to run after the test suite.
 * @param ... List of test cases.
 */
#define ztest_test_suite_with_setup_teardown(suite, suite_setup, suite_teardown, ...) \
	static const Z_STRUCT_SECTION_ITERABLE(ztest_suite_node, suite##_suite_node) = { \
		.name = #suite, \
		.unit_tests = (const struct ztest_unit_test[]){\
			__VA_ARGS__, \
			{ 0 } \
		}, \
		.suite_setup = suite_setup, \
		.suite_teardown = suite_teardown, \
	}

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite with rule.
 *
 * @param suite Name of the test suite.
 * @param before Function to run before each test case.
 * @param after Function to run after each test case.
 * @param ... List of test cases.
 */
#define ztest_test_suite_with_rule(suite, before, after, ...) \
	static const Z_STRUCT_SECTION_ITERABLE(ztest_suite_node, suite##_suite_node) = { \
		.name = #suite, \
		.unit_tests = (const struct ztest_unit_test[]){\
			__VA_ARGS__, \
			{ 0 } \
		}, \
		.before = before, \
		.after = after, \
	}

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite with a setup, teardown and rule functions.
 *
 * @param suite Name of the test suite.
 * @param suite_setup Function to run before the test suite.
 * @param suite_teardown Function to run after the test suite.
 * @param before Function to run before each test case.
 * @param after Function to run after each test case.
 * @param ... List of test cases.
 */
#define ztest_test_suite_with_setup_teardown_rule(suite, suite_setup, suite_teardown, before, after, ...) \
	static const Z_STRUCT_SECTION_ITERABLE(ztest_suite_node, suite##_suite_node) = { \
		.name = #suite, \
		.unit_tests = (const struct ztest_unit_test[]){\
			__VA_ARGS__, \
			{ 0 } \
		}, \
		.suite_setup = suite_setup, \
		.suite_teardown = suite_teardown, \
		.before = before, \
		.after = after, \
	}

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite.
 *
 * @deprecated Use @ref ztest_test_suite instead.
 *
 * @param suite Name of the test suite.
 * @param ... List of test cases.
 */
#define ztest_suite(suite, ...) \
	 ztest_test_suite(suite, __VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite with a setup and teardown functions.
 *
 * @deprecated Use @ref ztest_test_suite_with_setup_teardown instead.
 *
 * @param suite Name of the test suite.
 * @param suite_setup Function to run before the test suite.
 * @param suite_teardown Function to run after the test suite.
 * @param ... List of test cases.
 */
#define ztest_suite_with_setup_teardown(suite, suite_setup, suite_teardown, ...) \
	ztest_test_suite_with_setup_teardown(suite, suite_setup, suite_teardown, __VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite with rule.
 *
 * @deprecated Use @ref ztest_test_suite_with_rule instead.
 *
 * @param suite Name of the test suite.
 * @param before Function to run before each test case.
 * @param after Function to run after each test case.
 * @param ... List of test cases.
 */
#define ztest_suite_with_rule(suite, before, after, ...) \
	ztest_test_suite_with_rule(suite, before, after, __VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite with a setup, teardown and rule functions.
 *
 * @deprecated Use @ref ztest_test_suite_with_setup_teardown_rule instead.
 *
 * @param suite Name of the test suite.
 * @param suite_setup Function to run before the test suite.
 * @param suite_teardown Function to run after the test suite.
 * @param before Function to run before each test case.
 * @param after Function to run after each test case.
 * @param ... List of test cases.
 */
#define ztest_suite_with_setup_teardown_rule(suite, suite_setup, suite_teardown, before, after, ...) \
	ztest_test_suite_with_setup_teardown_rule(suite, suite_setup, suite_teardown, before, after, __VA_ARGS__)

/**
 * @}
 */

void ztest_run_test_suite(const char *name, struct ztest_suite_node *suite);
void ztest_run_registered_test_suites(const void *state);
int ztest_run_backend_tests(const void *state);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* ZEPHYR_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_TEST_H_ */
